title: ATOMS: ALMA Three-millimeter Observations of Massive Star-forming regions-VI. On the formation of the 'L' type filament in G286.21+0.17
question: Whether G286.21+0.17 is undergoing global collapse as suggested by single-dish line profiles, and how its 'L' type filament, outflows, and protocluster formed.

data.angular_resolution: ACA 7m: ~13''; 12-m: ~1.7''; combined continuum: 2.12'' x 2.29''; combined lines: 2.09'' x 2.26'' to 2.40'' x 2.61''
data.sensitivity: Continuum: 0.21 mJy (1 sigma); Lines: 0.004 to 0.012 Jy beam^-1

what.value: 76 dense cores identified in 1.3 mm ALMA continuum and their 'blue' and 'red' velocity groupings

evidence.quote: The 76 dense cores identified by 1.3mm continuum in C20 are marked by "+" in Fig. 3.
In C20, they divided the cores into two groups "blue" and "red" based on their velocity differences.

what.value: Radius R = 0.40 +/- 0.05 pc derived from H13CO+ J=1-0 emission

evidence.quote: The radius R derived from H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ J=1-0 emission is 0.40 $\pm$ 0.05 pc (see B10).

what.value: Hi-GAL column density and dust temperature maps processed by PPMAP

evidence.quote: The resolution of column density and dust temperature maps is $\sim12\ensuremath{''}$, and the resulting data is available online (cite: Marsh2017).

recipe.goal: Calculate central clump mass from PPMAP dust continuum maps
recipe.method: Average PPMAP column density and dust temperature within R ~ 0.44 pc circle (ALMA 12m FOV FWHM radius) and compute mass assuming spherical geometry
assumptions: Spherical geometry (n = N/2R) and mean molecular weight per free particle mu = 2.37

recipe.goal: Extract compact cores and filament skeletons, and measure filament width
recipe.method: Extract compact cores using the Dendrogram algorithm on 3 mm continuum and HC3N moment 0 maps; identify sub-filament skeletons with FILFINDER; fit radial profile of the longest sub-filament with Radfil and deconvolve with beam
key_parameters: Cut spacing ~ 3 pixels, background degree bgdegree = 1, Gaussian fitting range out to 0.3 pc, HPBW ~ 2.20''
assumptions: Deconvolved FWHM = sqrt(FWHM^2 - HPBW^2) with 3 mm continuum HPBW ~ 2.20''

recipe.goal: Cluster dense cores into sub-clumps via nearest neighbor separation analysis
recipe.method: Apply hierarchical clustering with Ward's linkage to the 76 1.3 mm dense cores from C20

recipe.goal: Extract spectra, moment maps, and position-velocity diagrams to resolve sub-clump kinematics and velocity gradients
recipe.method: Extract spectra averaged over a 36'' region from ACA 7m and 12m+7m data; compute moment 0 and moment 1 maps (using narrow velocity range [-23, -16.5] km s^-1 for 12m+7m moment 1 to reduce outflow contamination); construct PV diagrams along two perpendicular directions
key_parameters: Averaging aperture size = 36''; 12m+7m moment 1 velocity range = [-23, -16.5] km s^-1; ACA 7m blue/red integration ranges = [-60, -19.8] km s^-1 and [-19.8, 20] km s^-1

recipe.goal: Identify outflow lobes and fit SiO shock knot line profiles
recipe.method: Integrate high-velocity wings of HCO+ (1-0) and CS (2-1) in blueshifted [-41, -23] km s^-1 and redshifted [-16.5, 5] km s^-1 intervals; extract circle-averaged SiO (2-1) spectra at knots A-F and fit Gaussian profiles
key_parameters: Outflow velocity intervals: redshifted [-16.5, 5] km s^-1, blueshifted [-41, -23] km s^-1; SiO knot circle radii r = 2.10'' to 6.06''

recipe.goal: Compute clump virial mass, outflow-to-gas momentum and energy ratios, and outflow dynamical time
recipe.method: Calculate virial mass from H13CO+ J=1-0 linewidth and radius; calculate momentum and energy ratios P_out/P_gas and E_out/E_gas from moment 0 fluxes and median moment 1 velocities of HCO+ wings and H13CO+ sub-clumps; calculate outflow dynamical time from maximum lobe length and maximum velocities
key_parameters: v_out^r ~ 3.5 km s^-1, v_out^b ~ 3.8 km s^-1, v_gas^r ~ 1.0 km s^-1, v_gas^b ~ 1.1 km s^-1, lambda_max ~ 0.40 pc, R = 0.40 +/- 0.05 pc, Delta v ~ 1.46 km s^-1
assumptions: Spherical clump (a2 = 1), power-law density index p ~ 1.77, optically thin H13CO+ (1-0) and high-velocity HCO+ (1-0) wings, equal and constant excitation temperature, abundance ratio [H13CO+/HCO+] ~ 1/60, no projection effect for t_dyn

score_reason: Public ALMA project code (2019.1.00685.S), public PPMAP data, clearly stated software packages (CASA 5.6, FILFINDER, Radfil, Dendrogram, scipy), and explicit equations and velocity intervals for moment maps and outflow energetics; minor deductions for unstated tclean multiscale/threshold parameters, dendrogram/FILFINDER parameters, and exact PV slice coordinates.
